note: 十段流程迭代回顾双语草稿；设计：用十二次发布记录讨论等待和返工，保留独立审批、安全验证与兼容回滚，通过小范围试点评估改进。未配音，不填时间轴。

series.title: 发布流程回顾：少等待、少返工、不删门禁
series.premise: 迭代结束回顾十二次发布记录：审批等待中位数九十分钟，四次有构建返工，一次发生应用回滚。团队决定下一迭代流程试点。
series.outcome: 选择审批证据包和固定制品选择试点，保留独立审批、签名与秘密检查以及schema兼容证据。按至少十次可比发布评估等待和返工；样本不足延长观察，不把未完成目标包装成成功。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

recycling.note: 未来回访只是候选，不计已发生复现；本场仅引用既有库、S03至S07及本场此前段。

dialogues.title: 回顾目标是减少等待，不是减少检查
dialogues.premise: 两周迭代结束，团队拿十二次发布记录做流程回顾。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出回顾目标、样本边界和不做什么。

lines.en: Okay, today's retro looks at approval wait. Twelve releases give us initial evidence.
lines.zh: 好，今天回顾审批等待。十二次发布提供初步证据。

lines.en: Just to recap, our goal was less rework. We didn't quite achieve that yet.
lines.zh: 小结一下，目标是减少返工。我们还没完全做到。

lines.en: Twelve isn't a large sample though. Compare similar releases before claiming a trend.
lines.zh: 不过十二次样本不大。比较相似发布后再说趋势。

lines.en: Just to confirm, we're reviewing the process. Not judging individual developers here, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，评审的是流程，不是在这里评判开发个人，对吧？

lines.en: Agreed, keep security checks outside blame. We can improve waiting without weakening verification.
lines.zh: 同意，不责怪安全检查。可以改善等待，不削弱验证。

lines.en: We have bandwidth for two experiments. Each action item needs measurable acceptance.
lines.zh: 我们有能力做两个试验。每个行动项需要可测验收。

lines.en: And distinguish meeting estimates from recorded timings. Memory often overstates the worst release.
lines.zh: 区分会上估计和记录时间。记忆经常夸大最糟一次发布。

lines.en: So, let's park that platform rewrite. We'll start with the recorded approval timeline.
lines.zh: 那么平台重写先放一边。从记录的审批时间线开始。

lines.en: Use sanitized records for this discussion. Raw evidence may contain restricted customer details.
lines.zh: 讨论用脱敏记录。原始证据可能含受限客户细节。

lines.en: Fair, I brought the cleaned release summary. It separates waiting from active review time.
lines.zh: 明白，我带了清理后的发布摘要。它区分等待和实际评审时间。

dialogues.title: 瓶颈是排队，还是补证据
dialogues.premise: 回顾聚焦流程，两项试验额度；先分析审批等待记录。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出等待口径和证据缺失如何延长等待。

lines.en: Median approval wait was ninety minutes. Active review took roughly fifteen minutes usually.
lines.zh: 审批等待中位数九十分钟。实际评审通常约十五分钟。

lines.en: Okay, is reviewer bandwidth the approval bottleneck? Just to confirm, how's waiting measured?
lines.zh: 好，评审人时间是审批瓶颈吗？确认一下，等待怎么计？

lines.en: From submission until first substantive review. Follow-up delays are tracked separately, not hidden.
lines.zh: 从提交到首次实质评审。后续延迟单独跟踪，不隐藏。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis was reviewer overload. But five submissions lacked artifact evidence itself.
lines.zh: 当前假设原是评审超负荷。但五份提交缺制品证据本身。

lines.en: I couldn't assess those requests immediately. Asking for provenance isn't discretionary extra paperwork.
lines.zh: 那些请求无法立即评估。要求来源证明不是可选额外文书。

lines.en: We kept asking, what's the ETA? We should have supplied evidence first.
lines.zh: 我们一直在问：预计多久？应当先提供证据。

lines.en: Don't combine those medians into totals. They describe different distributions across twelve releases.
lines.zh: 不要把中位数相加成总时间。它们描述十二次发布的不同分布。

lines.en: So, reviewer slots and preparation both matter. We need fixes for both causes.
lines.zh: 那么评审时段和准备都重要。两种原因都要修。

lines.en: A scheduled slot helps complete requests most. Incomplete requests still need a named follow-up.
lines.zh: 预约时段对完整请求最有用。不完整请求仍需要指定跟进。

lines.en: Fair, I'll separate those categories in reporting. Otherwise we'd optimize the wrong queue.
lines.zh: 明白，我在报告区分类别。不然会优化错队列。

dialogues.title: 重跑不等于解决返工原因
dialogues.premise: 等待来自评审排队与证据准备不足，接着分析四次构建返工。
dialogues.listeningTask: 识别四次返工的分类及安全重试要求。

lines.en: Four releases entered a rework loop. Three had inconsistent dependency configuration across runners.
lines.zh: 四次发布陷入返工循环。三次执行器间依赖配置不一致。

lines.en: Okay, separate from the approval bottleneck then. Just to confirm, the fourth case?
lines.zh: 好，那与审批瓶颈分开。确认一下，第四次是什么？

lines.en: A consumer selected the wrong artifact. More retries didn't correct its selection policy.
lines.zh: 消费端选错制品。增加重试没有修正选择策略。

lines.en: That one was my test consumer. The moving tag caused ambiguity itself.
lines.zh: 那次是我的测试消费端。可变标签本身带来歧义。

lines.en: Use fixed digests with verified provenance. Signature checks must remain after selection changes.
lines.zh: 用固定摘要和验证来源。选择变更后签名检查仍保留。

lines.en: Managed configuration can align dependency sources. A cache hit still needs content verification.
lines.zh: 受管配置能对齐依赖源。缓存命中仍需内容验证。

lines.en: And distinguish deterministic failures from transient ones. Retries need bounds and stable operation keys.
lines.zh: 区分确定性与暂态失败。重试需要次数限制和稳定操作键。

lines.en: So, keep an eye on duplicate effects. Failed status doesn't prove nothing was published.
lines.zh: 那么关注重复副作用。失败状态不证明什么都没发布。

lines.en: Unknown results need receipt reconciliation first. Never bypass secret checks to finish a rerun.
lines.zh: 结果未知先核对回执。绝不能为了重跑完成绕过秘密检查。

lines.en: Fair, maybe digest selection is the smallest fix. I'll propose that alongside configuration alignment.
lines.zh: 明白，摘要选择可能是最小修复。我把它和配置对齐一起提议。

dialogues.title: 回滚成功，但准备证据还不够集中
dialogues.premise: 四次返工原因已分类；回顾其中一次发布后的应用回滚。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出回滚有效的兼容条件与证据检索痛点。

lines.en: One release tested rollback readiness for real. Old code recovered after the latency regression.
lines.zh: 一次发布真实检验回滚准备度。延迟回归后旧代码恢复了。

lines.en: Okay, outside the earlier rework loop? Just to confirm, same release count overall?
lines.zh: 好，在之前返工循环之外？确认一下，整体仍同一批发布次数？

lines.en: Yes, categories can overlap across releases. Don't add them as separate incident counts.
lines.zh: 对，分类可在发布间重叠。不能相加成不同故障数量。

lines.en: The rollback trigger fired as intended. Finding compatibility evidence took too long, right?
lines.zh: 回滚触发按预期生效。找兼容证据花太久，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, nullable expansion preserved old writes. Old readers also handled candidate-written rows correctly.
lines.zh: 对，可空扩展保留旧写入。旧读取也正确处理候选写出的行。

lines.en: Our mixed-version smoke test existed already. But its link wasn't in the release ticket.
lines.zh: 混合版本冒烟测试早已存在。但链接不在发布工单里。

lines.en: Retained old artifacts had valid signatures. We didn't rebuild or copy secret values.
lines.zh: 保留旧制品有有效签名。没有重建或复制秘密值。

lines.en: So, improve retrieval before the next go/no-go. Not remove compatibility checks to save time.
lines.zh: 那么下次继续判断前改善检索。不是为了省时删兼容检查。

lines.en: Schema contraction would have blocked safe rollback. Keep that as a separately approved stage.
lines.zh: 结构收缩会阻止安全回滚。保留它为独立审批阶段。

lines.en: Fair, I'll link evidence near the operation. That makes the next decision less uncertain.
lines.zh: 明白，我把证据链接放在操作旁。下次决策更少不确定性。

dialogues.title: 先看风险，再看节省的分钟
dialogues.premise: 等待、四次返工和一次回滚已回顾，需在两项试验额度内排序。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出排序异议如何改变优先级理由。

lines.en: Okay, let's rank the pain points. We have bandwidth for two experiments only.
lines.zh: 好，给痛点排序。我们只有做两个试验的人手。

lines.en: Approval waiting costs the most visible time. I'd put that action item first.
lines.zh: 审批等待占最多可见时间。我想把那个行动项排第一。

lines.en: I disagree with time alone as ranking. Rollback readiness protects against larger business harm.
lines.zh: 我不同意只按时间排。回滚准备保护更大的业务损失。

lines.en: Just to confirm, not another rollback project? Evidence packaging could address both concerns, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，不是另起回滚项目？证据打包可以同时解决两种担忧，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, if it includes compatibility and identity. A faster empty ticket improves nothing useful.
lines.zh: 对，前提含兼容和身份。更快的空工单没有实际改善。

lines.en: Then fixed artifact selection is second. It removes a concrete source of rework.
lines.zh: 那固定制品选择排第二。它移除具体返工来源。

lines.en: Existing configuration alignment stays mandatory maintenance. Don't make established safety work optional experiments.
lines.zh: 现有配置对齐仍是强制维护。别把既定安全工作变成可选试验。

lines.en: So, let's park that dashboard redesign. Package evidence first, fix selection second.
lines.zh: 那么面板重设计先放一边。证据打包第一，修选择第二。

lines.en: Record why we chose those changes. Risk reduction matters alongside shorter elapsed time.
lines.zh: 记录为什么选择这些变更。降低风险和缩短时间同样重要。

lines.en: Fair, I'm comfortable with that ordering. We still need acceptance and ownership details.
lines.zh: 明白，我接受这个排序。仍需要验收和职责细节。

dialogues.title: 自动收集证据，人工独立审批
dialogues.premise: 选择证据打包和固定制品选择两个试验，提出具体流程。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分自动预检与审批权，听出新内容如何使旧审批失效。

lines.en: The evidence bundle collects digest and provenance. Also signature results and compatibility test links.
lines.zh: 证据包收集摘要和来源，还含签名结果和兼容测试链接。

lines.en: Okay, rank the pain points by missing evidence. Just to confirm, no automatic approval?
lines.zh: 好，按缺失证据整理痛点。确认一下，不自动审批？

lines.en: Correct, preflight checks completeness, not judgment. Approval remains explicit for environment and digest.
lines.zh: 对，预检查完整性，不做判断。审批仍明确绑定环境和摘要。

lines.en: We can dry-run it first in staging. Changed digest invalidates old approval itself.
lines.zh: 可以先在预发布预演。摘要变化使旧审批本身失效。

lines.en: Store restricted links, not secret values. Redaction and access controls need acceptance tests.
lines.zh: 存受限链接，不存秘密值。脱敏和访问控制需要验收测试。

lines.en: Managed configuration supplies the template version. I'll attach the selected artifact's source commit.
lines.zh: 受管配置提供模板版本。我附选中制品的源码提交。

lines.en: Include retained rollback digest and schema conditions. A link saying rollback exists isn't enough.
lines.zh: 包括保留回滚摘要和结构条件。只说有回滚的链接不够。

lines.en: So, reviewers get complete requests at reserved slots. We'll close the loop with their findings.
lines.zh: 那么评审人在预约时段拿完整请求。我们用评审发现反馈闭环。

lines.en: Missing or invalid signatures must block submission. Suspected secret exposure follows revocation and escalation.
lines.zh: 缺失或无效签名必须阻止提交。疑似秘密泄漏按撤销和升级处理。

lines.en: Fair, not just another checklist checkbox. I'll test stale evidence against changed content.
lines.zh: 明白，不只是另一个清单复选框。我测旧证据与变更内容的情况。

dialogues.title: 谁维护证据，谁有权审批
dialogues.premise: 流程提案保留独立审批，需解决开发、平台与安全的维护边界。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出职责争议及独立审批不能自行豁免的原因。

lines.en: Who's picking this up for evidence maintenance? Apps can't own every platform template change.
lines.zh: 证据维护谁接？应用不能负责所有平台模板变更。

lines.en: Okay, separation of duties matters here. Just to confirm, reviewers stay independent?
lines.zh: 好，职责分离在这里重要。确认一下，评审人保持独立？

lines.en: Yes, authors can't approve their own releases. A backup approver needs formally delegated authority.
lines.zh: 对，作者不能审批自己的发布。后备审批人需要正式授权。

lines.en: I'll own the evidence bundle collector. Applications own their compatibility evidence itself.
lines.zh: 我负责证据包收集器。应用负责兼容证据本身。

lines.en: Security owns policy and independent risk review. Platform authors don't grant themselves exceptions.
lines.zh: 安全负责政策和独立风险评审。平台作者不能自授例外。

lines.en: That sounds fairer than shared ownership. But I need bandwidth for new tests.
lines.zh: 这比共同负责公平。但我需要时间写新测试。

lines.en: I can support compatibility fixture design. Signoff still belongs to the accountable application owner.
lines.zh: 我能支持兼容样例设计。签收仍属负责任的应用负责人。

lines.en: So, let's take it offline for implementation details. Ownership decisions remain in this record.
lines.zh: 那么实施细节会后处理。职责决定留在这份记录里。

lines.en: Also name the fallback reviewer explicitly. Being reachable doesn't automatically confer approval authority.
lines.zh: 也明确后备评审人。联系得到不自动意味着有审批权。

lines.en: Fair, Priya will confirm delegated coverage tomorrow. Until then we keep existing approval routing.
lines.zh: 明白，Priya明天确认授权覆盖。之前保持现有审批路由。

dialogues.title: 少等待不是唯一成功条件
dialogues.premise: 证据收集、应用验收与独立审批职责已明确，制定试点指标。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出成功标准、样本不足条件和安全失败停止条件。

lines.en: Okay, pilot success criteria need real samples. At least ten comparable production releases.
lines.zh: 好，试点成功标准需要真实样本。至少十次可比生产发布。

lines.en: Median approval wait below forty-five minutes. At most one rework release in ten.
lines.zh: 审批等待中位数低于四十五分钟。十次中最多一次返工发布。

lines.en: Compare similar risk classes and working hours. Include total completion time alongside first-review waiting.
lines.zh: 比较相似风险类别和工作时段。首次评审等待之外也报总完成时间。

lines.en: Just to confirm, two weeks isn't guaranteed enough? Low volume means more observation, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，两周不保证够？量少就延长观察，对吧？

lines.en: Correct, no skipped approvals or verification gates. Zero secret exposure is a required guardrail.
lines.zh: 对，不能跳审批或验证门禁。零秘密泄漏是必要护栏。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on duplicate operations. Receipt reconciliation tests must pass before pilot launch.
lines.zh: 我关注重复操作。回执核对测试必须在试点开始前通过。

lines.en: Invalid artifact selection triggers a pilot stop. That rollback trigger restores the previous workflow.
lines.zh: 无效制品选择触发试点停止。这个回退条件恢复旧工作流。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for the first review? Day five for an interim check.
lines.zh: 那么首次评审预计何时？第五天做中期检查。

lines.en: Exposure also stops the pilot immediately. Revoke affected credentials and use the security process.
lines.zh: 泄漏也立即停止试点。撤销受影响凭据并走安全流程。

lines.en: Fair, I'll report exceptions and missing samples. We won't call incomplete evidence a success.
lines.zh: 明白，我报告例外和缺失样本。不把不完整证据说成成功。

dialogues.title: 顺延次要工作，保护试点范围
dialogues.premise: 至少十次可比发布、等待与返工目标以及停止条件已定，安排两周迭代。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出顺延事项与不能顺延的安全验收。

lines.en: Okay, carry over the dashboard redesign. Current bandwidth supports our two bounded experiments.
lines.zh: 好，面板重设计顺延。当前人手支持两个边界明确试验。

lines.en: First action item is the collector. I'll have a testable version by Wednesday.
lines.zh: 第一个行动项是收集器。周三前我交可测版本。

lines.en: I'll review schema evidence templates on Thursday. No pilot release before acceptance is complete.
lines.zh: 周四我评审结构证据模板。验收完成前不发布试点版本。

lines.en: Just to confirm, pilot success criteria stay fixed? We can't relax them halfway, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，试点成功标准固定？不能中途放宽，对吧？

lines.en: Changes require a documented team decision. Mandatory security controls can't be negotiated away.
lines.zh: 变更需要团队记录决定。强制安全控制不能协商取消。

lines.en: Let's park that extra cache optimization too. It would expand the pilot unnecessarily.
lines.zh: 额外缓存优化也先放一边。它会无必要地扩大试点。

lines.en: Configuration drift repair stays existing maintenance work. Don't defer required correctness fixes as optional scope.
lines.zh: 配置漂移修复仍是现有维护。别把必要正确性修复当可选范围延期。

lines.en: So, launch only after acceptance by Friday. Otherwise shift launch, not the safety checks.
lines.zh: 那么周五验收后才开始。否则移动开始日期，不移动安全检查。

lines.en: I'll test evidence access and redaction Thursday. A backup independent reviewer must be confirmed beforehand.
lines.zh: 周四我测证据访问和脱敏。之前必须确认独立后备评审人。

lines.en: Fair, digest selection tests are mine Wednesday. I can commit to that smaller scope.
lines.zh: 明白，周三摘要选择测试归我。这个较小范围我能承诺。

dialogues.title: 用证据跟进，不只写行动清单
dialogues.premise: 试点职责、验收与日期已确认，最后复述行动和后续回顾方式。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出谁做什么、何时检查，以及何时还不能宣布成功。

lines.en: Okay, we need to follow through now. Just to recap, two experiments, not five.
lines.zh: 好，现在需要持续落实。小结一下，两个试验，不是五个。

lines.en: Collector Wednesday; audited retry tests before launch. We'll carry over unrelated performance ideas.
lines.zh: 周三收集器，开始前审计重试测试。无关性能想法顺延。

lines.en: Thursday I'll verify retained rollback evidence. Old readers and writers need demonstrated compatibility.
lines.zh: 周四我验证保留回滚证据。旧读取和写入需要证明兼容。

lines.en: Just to confirm, selection tests are mine Wednesday. Provenance verification itself stays required alongside signatures.
lines.zh: 确认一下，周三选择测试归我。来源验证本身与签名一样仍为必须。

lines.en: I'll review access and redaction Thursday. Independent approval remains required for each target digest.
lines.zh: 周四我评审访问和脱敏。每个目标摘要仍需要独立审批。

lines.en: We'll circle back on pilot day five. I'll close the loop with interim findings.
lines.zh: 试点第五天再确认。我用中期发现反馈闭环。

lines.en: Interim findings aren't proof of final success. Fewer than ten comparable releases requires extended observation.
lines.zh: 中期发现不是最终成功证明。少于十次可比发布就延长观察。

lines.en: So, report waiting and rework together. Include blocked requests, not just completed approvals.
lines.zh: 那么一起报等待和返工。包括阻止的请求，不只完成审批。

lines.en: And every waived gate would invalidate success. Efficiency shouldn't conceal newly introduced security risk.
lines.zh: 任何门禁豁免都会使成功无效。效率不能隐藏新引入的安全风险。

lines.en: Fair, maybe we won't hit every target. We'll keep the evidence honest and learn.
lines.zh: 明白，可能达不到所有目标。我们保持证据诚实并学习。
